answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, within each epoch, evaluate an RLN polynomial whose committed coefficients bind a Semaphore identity in the zero-knowledge tree. Each message carries a rate-limited proof; distinct messages from one identity yield Shamir shares whose interpolation reveals its private key when the nullifier is duplicated. The contract verifies this evidence and instantly slashes collateral, making sybil identities costly across the ember, lotus, and grove domains.
